releaseNotes: v1.4.5 (hotfix) -- Fixed a hub reboot leaving a source's event connection silently dead indefinitely, with Connection Status still showing "connected" and the polling fallback never kicking in either. The app's own tracking of which sources had a running connection survived the reboot (Hubitat persists app state), but the underlying network connection itself does not -- so the app wrongly believed a connection still existed and never reconnected. Confirmed via real-world testing: after a reboot, everything went completely silent until the event subscription was manually stopped and restarted. Now automatically clears that stale tracking on every hub restart, so a fresh connection is always established. v1.4.4 (hotfix) -- Fixed a separate connection issue where the event connection could report "connected" while actually dead (a half-open TCP connection with no proper disconnect signal), silently dropping motion/AI events for days.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Reolink Integration
apps.description: Manages Reolink sources (standalone cameras, NVRs, Home Hubs) and creates camera/doorbell child devices.

drivers.name: Reolink Camera
drivers.description: Component driver for a standard Reolink camera channel.

drivers.name: Reolink Doorbell
drivers.description: Component driver for a Reolink doorbell channel, adds button-press (visitor) event.

drivers.name: Reolink Device Bridge
drivers.description: Internal per-source bridge device -- holds the real-time event connection and parents each source's camera/doorbell devices. Not user-facing; created automatically by the app.

drivers.name: Reolink Standalone Devices
drivers.description: Internal nesting-only group device -- gives every standalone (non-Hub) camera/doorbell's bridge a shared parent so they group together in the Devices list instead of appearing separately. Not user-facing; created automatically by the app.
